palette: deep revolutionary red ground + pale parchment panels + gold star accents + dark ink annotations + warm amber highlights
typography: ink headings on parchment panels, dark chronicle label tabs with gold left bar, gold star stamps for milestones, red chips for period names, thin ink underline for dates
composition: the four constitutional documents unfold as a chronological banner row; the judicial scene highlights the Ma Xiwu trial method and people's mediation as twin pillars
surface: flat deep red ground with faint banner hairlines, parchment panels with hairline weathered borders and corner star pins, no gradients, no rounded cards, no drop shadows
motion: parchment panels rise chronologically, date stamps land once, star accents light up, the twin pillars settle side by side
transition: a banner unfurls and the chronicle clears for the next document
